species.name: Trout
why: Water 51°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–22 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 85 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 16–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 85 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southeast wind at 25 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
